description:
Get subcellular localization annotations for a target protein.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_subcellular_locations — one record = one subcellular location of one gene from one source.
Key: id, subcellularLocations[].location, subcellularLocations[].source.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: one row = one item (one subcellular location of one gene from one source); `_vbt.total` counts items.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Subcellular locations (HPA, UniProt) integrated by OT 25.09; a missing location means not reported.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
